guide.title: Lugbug_Level_10_Gift_Box
guide.message:
Lugbug's Level 10 Gift Box

The Return to Adventure Event offers ways for you to unlock powerful loot as you progress through the various levels within Aion. Secure yourself mounds of Tough Acorns, unique mounts, level-specific Gift Boxes, Legendary Transformation Potions, and more!



Happy hunting!



~Server staff
guide.select: Have Fun and Enjoy on Aion Classic!
